status.note: Storage/deployment implementation is intentionally not embedded in the metamodel.

role: Defines the grammar used to author and validate CKO M2 metamodels.

model_chain.M2: Metamodels defining governed resource kinds and semantics.
model_chain.M1: Executable projections such as JSON Schema, SHACL, OPA/Rego, SQL DDL and contracts.
model_chain.M0: Concrete governed resource instances and artifact metadata.

non_goals: Does not prescribe local filesystem, cloud provider, Supabase, Vercel or any host.
Does not make the Kernel cognitive.
Does not claim full ISO/IEC 11179 conformity without clause-level licensed-source validation.

hosting_future_profile.rule: Hosting is a deployment profile and must not alter canonical object semantics.
